Launch date: September 7, 2018
Source: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Launch site: Taiyaun Space Center, China (TSC)

HAIYANG 1C is a Chinese HaiYang (abbreviated HY) marine remote sensing satellite. The satellite features an improved coastal scanner with a resolution of 50 m, two new instruments - an ultraviolet imager and a calibration spectrometer and an AIS system for ship tracking.
